requirements.description: User wants healthcare services nearby for an autonomous senior day center (CDIA). 'Nearby' is a proximity expression, so the value is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

The user requires energy class D or better. This covers all classes from D upward: A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C and D. The area, capacity and healthcare-proximity requirements are not energy-related and are outside this agent's scope.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 360. Capacity for 18 people is not a surface requirement and was not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class, healthcare proximity, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area of at least 360 sqm, energy class A1 through D, and healthcare score of at least 75. Location is limited to a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892 using latitude/longitude, and results are ordered by distance from that point. The 18-person capacity requirement is not a schema column and was not in the extracted requirements, so it is not applied.
